hook.text: Plumbers miss up to forty percent of their calls, and eighty-five percent of those callers never call back. That's thirteen thousand dollars a month, gone.

save.text: Missed call, texted in eight seconds, called back in fifty-two, booked. Three hundred and twenty dollars recovered.

est.text: And the estimates nobody chased? The agent follows up, handles the objection, and closes.

cta.text: Want your missed calls and unsold estimates recovered? Let's build it.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Hi Maria, Sam from Blue Ridge Plumbing — sorry we missed you, the crew was under a sink. What's going on?

call1.speaker: caller
call1.text: My kitchen sink is completely backed up, nothing's draining.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: We can be there today, two to four — the $89 dispatch fee goes toward the repair. Book it?

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Booked. You'll get a text with the plumber's name and a tracking link.

call2.speaker: alex
call2.text: Hi Tom, Sam from Blue Ridge — checking in on the water heater estimate we sent Monday. Any questions?

call2.speaker: caller
call2.text: Honestly it's the price. Twenty-four hundred — we were going to wait.

call2.speaker: alex
call2.text: Fair. We can do zero percent for twelve months — two hundred a month — and install Thursday morning. Hold Thursday?
